regions.name: Tarragon
regions.lore: Tarragon is now a single corrupted western kingdom formed from Dsärr, Edresan and Yán. With Dsärr at its heart and the other two realms folded within its borders, Zuläch rules the whole western mass as Saar’s throne made flesh.

regions.name: Dsärr
regions.lore: Once ruled by Zhäro, Dsärr now sits at the centre of Tarragon as its ancient heart-realm. Its older identity survives in memory, but its lands are now bound into the larger corrupted western kingdom.

regions.name: Edresan
regions.lore: Edresan, once Qadril’s power base, now lies within Tarragon’s western domain. Its ambition and opportunistic politics helped the three western realms collapse into a single throne.

regions.name: Yán
regions.lore: Yán, formerly ruled by Domiyán, is now the third realm held within Tarragon’s borders. Its fate is inseparable from the corruption spreading outward under Saar’s influence.

regions.name: Mountains of Shal Mur
regions.lore: Beneath Shal Mur lie the Four Eternal Chains — Order, Will, Form and Veil — the ancient bindings that imprisoned Saar after the Sundering. Zuläch shattered the Chain of Will here and allowed Saar’s essence to enter him.

regions.name: Corruption Stronghold
regions.lore: A forward bastion along Tarragon’s fractured border, where corruption presses into the neighbouring lands and distorts old roads and watchlines.

regions.name: Vulcaria
regions.lore: Vulcaria is the volcanic kingdom of Queen Olorus. Calderas, lava fields and geothermal nesting grounds shape its way of life, and its fire-tempered people endure heat, ash and upheaval better than most.

regions.name: The Amber Isles
regions.lore: A chain of smaller northern islands that divide shipping lanes and provide stopping points between the western coast, Amexore and Brigachian waters.

regions.name: Amexore
regions.lore: Ruled by Queen Teri’itaria, Amexore safeguards hidden archives, forbidden records and the knowledge that first revealed Saar’s return to the eastern courts.

regions.name: Brigachian
regions.lore: The frozen northern frontier, marked by ice-choked seas, remote watchpoints and harsh maritime routes. Brigachian secures the far north and monitors cold-water approaches.

regions.name: Aeyantis
regions.blurb: Radiant Kingdom of the Sun Court
regions.lore: Queen Ahris rules Aeyantis, the radiant eastern kingdom. Here Lumyrion was awakened and entrusted to the bearer chosen to carry the light west toward Tarragon.

regions.name: Your Journey Begins Here
regions.blurb: Starting point of the royal charge
regions.lore: The journey begins at the eastern edge of Aeyantis, where the bearer departs with Lumyrion and follows the marked route across sea lanes, ports and borderlands toward the corrupted west.

regions.name: Crown’s Gate Isles
regions.lore: These island enclaves sit between Aeyantis and Katzh, funnelling sea trade, envoys and information through one of the most strategic corridors in the Enën Sea.

regions.name: Katzh
regions.blurb: Crownlands — Kingdom of Law and Trade
regions.lore: Katzh is a disciplined mercantile kingdom whose harbours, ledgers and legal order help stabilise movement between the eastern and central realms.

regions.name: Dreonathen
regions.lore: Ruled by King Diogenes, Dreonathen stands as a defensive buffer between the heartlands and the west. Its roads, forts and disciplined people form a living shield against the advance of corruption.

regions.name: Kithren
regions.lore: Kithren’s old forests, misted valleys and hidden paths are ruled by Queen Kelisth. As corruption spreads, Kithren is among the first realms to feel its pressure along the western woodland frontier.

regions.name: The Verdant Reaches
regions.lore: This lush transitional zone softens the edge between volcanic terrain and the greener central lands. It holds passes, river mouths and concealed movement routes.

regions.name: Lycaen Hunting Enclave
regions.blurb: Forest outpost in Kithren’s deep woods
regions.lore: A hunting enclave deep in the mistwoods, known for stealth, tracking and the dangerous predators that roam beneath the canopy.

regions.name: Velmist Isles
regions.blurb: Low isles in the southern waters
regions.lore: A dispersed island chain in the lower sea, often used by sailors as weather shelters and by wanderers avoiding the more watched eastern routes.

regions.name: The Whispering Reefs
regions.lore: A maze of reefs, wreck routes and hidden anchorages, notorious for pirates, smugglers and rumours that carry farther than ships.

regions.name: The Sundried Atolls
regions.lore: These exposed atolls are strewn with old stonework and broken foundations — remnants of forgotten settlements now left to salt, wind and patient tides.

regions.name: The Duskreach
regions.lore: A remote and ominous quarter of the world where the sea darkens and strange violet disturbances stain the land. It lies beyond the main road to Tarragon, but not beyond the world’s growing unease.

regions.name: The Leviathan Depths
regions.lore: A feared lower-sea trench where the water seems unnaturally heavy and soundless. Mariners whisper of immense things moving in the black beneath.

regions.name: Southwind Expanse
regions.lore: An open southern expanse of sea and scattered landfall, charted only in part and often left deliberately vague on the maps of the Six Crowns.

regions.name: The Bleakfen Mire
regions.lore: A dim marsh and fen region, difficult to cross and thick with stagnant waters, fog and old stories best left untold.

regions.name: The Fogbound Wilds
regions.lore: A remote wildland of cold mist, broken ground and uncertain footing. It marks one of the most isolated corners of the southern-western world.

creatures.name: Gortusk
creatures.lore: Gortusks are armoured titans of volcanic terrain whose tusks and plated shells make them natural siege-breakers. They roam the ash highlands around Vulcaria rather than serving any ruler outright.

creatures.name: Megalore
creatures.lore: A colossal predator of the far northern waters. Megalore stalks the frozen reach beyond Brigachian, threatening ships that wander too close to the deep cold routes.

creatures.name: Ly’cara
creatures.lore: Fast and shadow-quiet, Ly’cara packs hunt through Kithren’s deeper woods. They know the fog better than any traveller does.

creatures.name: Cyrenthos
creatures.lore: Ancient creatures twisted by corruption and found near the scarred valleys between the western frontier and Dreonathen. Their presence often signals that the land itself is starting to change.

creatures.name: Deep Abyssal
creatures.lore: Towering abyssal beings are said to rise from the deep trenches east of the main sea routes, warping current, darkness and sound around them.
